selection_rationale: Pi has three distinct objects; only pi-agent-core is the agent runtime.
DSH's installed pi-ai is 1.4.0, so v1.4.0 is the coherent candidate for a like-for-like phase 3 comparison.
The tag and package manifests were verified remotely, but no Pi runtime is installed locally.
dsh-llm-pi-ai must not be used as a stand-in for Pi Agent Runtime.
phase3_preconditions: Obtain explicit user approval before installing any Pi package.
Install into an isolated temporary directory outside the repository and outside user data roots.
Pin Pi to tag v1.4.0 / commit 4a080252f06caf63a525d7873c5d94d3c23887e0 unless the lead records a different verified version.
Do not call a model until endpoint, credential and data-use authorization are separately approved.
Use the same model, task, tool set and prompt capture for DSH and Pi; record exact tool schemas and system prompts.
Treat pi-coding-agent as an integration shell; compare agent behavior through pi-agent-core where possible.
